warnings.label: Hunstanton coast in Norfolk
warnings.message:
Strong winds and large waves this evening may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from 16:45am to 20:15am on Friday 9th October.
Locations most affected will be low lying land and roads near rivers or on the coast, with spray being seeing on the seafront paths. Flood gates in the area will be closed by the Local Authority which will make access difficult. Please take notice of the Flood Sign at top of South Beach Road. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at King's Lynn of 3.74mAODN at 18:15, on 9 October, which is 0.22m above tide tables, Wind Force 6,  Westerley. The high tide tomorrow at 06:30am is expected to also be above flood alert thresholds at 4.04mAODN.
We are closely monitoring the situation .
Avoid beaches and coastal promenades, which may be flooded.  
This message will be updated by 8:00PM on Friday 09 October or as the situation changes.

warnings.label: The tidal Deben estuary
warnings.message:
High tides overnight may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible on consecutive tides from 11pm on Friday 9th October through to 1am on Saturday 10th October. 
Tide levels will be high around the boat yard in Felixstowe Ferry hamlet at the end of Ferry Road, and along riverside areas in Woodbridge and Waldringfield, as well as in surrounding marshland. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at Harwich of 2.60mAODN at 12am, on Saturday 10th October, which is 0.5m above tide tables, Wind Force 6, Westerly. Tides will remain high over the next couple of days. 
We are closely monitoring the situation . 
Avoid coastal roads, footpaths and carparks, which may be flooded.   
This message will be updated by 9:00AM on Saturday 10 October or as the situation changes.
